lines.trans: Vika, look at that lady.
Well, how is she behaving?
Everything seems completely fine.
She is talking on the phone for a long time.
She is simply dining in our dining room.
But she is not eating anything.
Maybe the dish is too hot?
She just asked for the bill.
Is she a restaurant critic or not?
We are still not sure.
We need to urgently find out the whole truth.
I will find out everything right now, chef.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

выяснить.gloss: to find out, clarify, sort out

examples.trans: Have we sorted all this out?
I'll find everything out right now.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

examples.text: Красивая дама сидела у большого окна.
examples.trans: A beautiful lady was sitting by the large window.
He talks for a long time.

meanings.note: not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)
adds emphasis to the word before it
как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: The restaurant critic praised the bartender.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

meanings.note: + genitive: ни копейки = not a penny
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

meanings.en: to have lunch, eat midday meal

examples.trans: Are we going to have lunch today?

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: This is some kind of mistake!
I wanted to ask you something.

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.trans: A restaurant critic came into the hall.

meanings.note: used in 'до сих пор' = until now, up to this point

examples.text: Я до сих пор ничего не понял.
Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

examples.text: Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный.
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident.
He answered in a calm, confident voice.
I'll find out where he is.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
